data.name: Tile Blast - Puzzle Game
data.detailed_description:
Tile Blast

Welcome to Tile Blast, a relaxing yet highly addictive block puzzle game that challenges your strategy and decision-making skills.

Place colorful blocks on the board, complete lines to clear them, and keep the playing field open for as long as possible. Every move matters, and a single mistake can quickly fill the board. Plan ahead, think strategically, and aim for the highest score.

Whether you're looking for a quick break or hours of satisfying gameplay, Tile Blast offers a simple experience that's easy to learn but difficult to master.

But there’s more than just solo play…

Duel Mode - Face Off Against Real Players

Think you’ve mastered the board? In Duel Mode, you go head-to-head with another player in real time. Every move becomes a battle of wits, where one smart placement can turn the tide and one mistake can seal your defeat.

Outplay your opponent, block their strategy, and survive longer to claim victory. The pressure rises with every turn, and only the most focused players will dominate the arena.

Are you ready to prove you're better than the rest?

Key Features

  • Endless block puzzle gameplay

  • Real-time Duel Mode against other players

  • Easy to learn, challenging to master

  • No time limits - play at your own pace

  • Smooth and satisfying line-clearing mechanics

  • Clean visuals and relaxing atmosphere

  • Track your best scores and challenge yourself

  • Optimized for both short sessions and long playtimes

Test Your Strategy

Success in Tile Blast isn't just about placing blocks - it's about planning several moves ahead. Manage your space carefully, create opportunities for large clears, and see how long you can survive.

In Duel Mode, every decision becomes a weapon. One clever move can trap your opponent… or leave you with nowhere to go.

Can you set a new high score, defeat real players, and become a true Tile Blast master?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any device capable of making noise
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any device capable of making noise 2

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or Apple Integrated Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Anything that makes sound
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon Integrated Graphics or Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Preferably one that makes the blocks sound satisfying.
